source.title: Irish News, 6 June 1936, p. 9 ("North Antrim results"); Irish News, 5 May 1936, p. 5
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: divisions, names, votes, registers, spoiled papers and percentage polls read from the Irish News's Newry (No. 1) Rural District Council returns (6 June 1936, p. 9)

note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling took place on Thursday 4 June 1936 and the three contested results were announced by Mr. W. B. O'Donoghue, deputy returning officer, in the boardroom of the Newry workhouse. Only these three divisions were contested. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Fegan, the outgoing member. 301 (77.3 per cent) voted, with four spoiled papers.
